turns.question: For leads that turned into a booking in September 2026, what was the median number of days from lead creation to booking?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no median or average of days from lead creation to booking. The closest metrics are lead_to_booking_rate (share of leads that booked within 30 days of being created), bookings and leads; I can give any of those for September 2026 if you want.
